title: eval-harness: per-prompt quality gating CI hook and metrics integration
author: Samir Kapoor
release_notes: Adds a per-prompt quality gating CI hook to the eval-harness which fails PRs when specified prompt-sets regress against configured metric thresholds. Integrates gating outputs into CI annotations and metrics dashboard.
body: Motivation: We need faster, deterministic detection of prompt-set regressions before changes reach main. This PR adds a per-prompt quality gating CI hook that runs as part of the eval-harness workflow and fails the PR when any prompt in a configured set drops below threshold on configured metrics. The gating hook supports multiple metrics (accuracy/EM, ROUGE, token-level logprob deltas) and allows per-prompt thresholds and weightings so teams can declare which prompts are critical. Design summary: 1) A new CI workflow step (eval-harness/.github/workflows/eval-ci.yml) now triggers a gated eval runner for changed prompts. 2) A gating plugin (eval-harness/hooks/per_prompt_gating.py) wraps the existing eval runner to compute per-prompt metrics, compare against baseline thresholds stored in eval-harness/config/prompt_baselines.json, and emit a compact JSON artifact and CI annotations. 3) An integration to internal metrics (Telemetry/metrics client) posts summary metrics to the eval metrics dashboard and flags regressions for alerting. 4) Tests: unit tests for gating logic and an integration test harness to exercise a small prompt-set are added. Non-goals: this PR does not add UI for managing baselines (will follow in ENG-2201). Checklist: - [x] Add gating hook and tests - [x] Wire into eval CI workflow - [x] Create baseline format and example baselines - [x] Add metrics emission and annotations - [x] Update docs (docs/eval-harness/gating.md) Backwards compatibility: default configuration is inert unless a repo opt-in file is present (eval-harness/config/repo_gating.json). Security: gating runner runs under same sandbox as evals and respects workspace secrets. Related: ENG-2148 (per-prompt gating), SUP-987 (customer regression report).
